AI engine settings

Writing hints/scoring, paragraph feedback, and Speaking scoring all run on Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite using the key below. To score Speaking from the actual audio (real pronunciation and intonation, not just the transcript), Gemini listens to the audio directly. Paste your key once and it is saved in this browser only — get a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey.

Paste the folder ID below (the long string in the folder URL after /folders/) and your OAuth Client ID (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com). Drive's file-listing endpoint does not accept plain API keys, so this signs you in to your own Google account instead — read-only, once per session, and nothing is stored. For correct section formats, put four subfolders inside the folder named Section 1 … Section 4; the generator then picks one audio at random from each. A flat folder also works, but every section is drawn from the same pool.

In Google Cloud → APIs & Services: enable the Google Drive API, then under Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client IDs create a Web application client and add this site to Authorised JavaScript origins. On the OAuth consent screen (External / Testing) add your own Google address as a test user. Requires https — it will not work from a local file:// copy.

Auto uses the best engine you have configured, in this order: DeepL proxy → Google → Gemini → MyMemory. MyMemory needs no setup at all and is what runs out of the box, so the translator works before you configure anything. Conjugation tables, register-ranked alternatives and collocations always run on the Gemini key above — no translation API on the market returns verb forms.

A separate key from the Gemini one: in Google Cloud enable Cloud Translation API, then create an API key under Credentials. 100+ languages, and the free tier covers ordinary classroom use. If you restrict the key by HTTP referrer, allow this page's address.

DeepL is the most accurate engine for European languages but refuses browser requests by design (403 + CORS), so it cannot be called from this page directly. Point this at a small proxy you run — DeepL publishes a ready-made one — and paste its base URL, e.g. https://your-worker.workers.dev. Leave the key blank if the proxy already holds it.

⚠️ Important: this key is used directly from your browser and is visible to anyone who inspects this page's network traffic. That's fine for your own personal use, but never share this exported HTML file with your key already saved in it — if you want students to use Speaking scoring too, each of them should add their own key, or you should route requests through a small server you control that holds the key instead.

Tip: “Test connection” checks your key against Google and lists the model IDs it can actually use — the fastest way to fix “no content” errors.

Session save & load

Export today's progress — scores, answers, drafts, AI-generated exam content — to a file you can keep or share, then load it later to pick up exactly where you left off. Saving again just overwrites with your newest progress.

Loading a file replaces current answers/drafts/generated content with whatever is in that file.
